title: Sitting in a Bossa Nova Dream
style: jazz, upbeat jazz; samba-inspired rhythm; female vocals
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I can be an uptown bluebird, downtown cool
In the pocket with a little extra room
Your inner-city pregame for that after-party chill
The centerpiece of every city on the hill
So you don't need to ask me how I feel
I can do it all, for real

[Pre-Chorus]
'Cause I've been all the way to Rio
I've been down the river, baby, I've been home
And I'm sitting in a bossa nova dream
I could never really be
[Chorus]
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Everything, everything, everything
Everything, everything, everything

[Verse 2]
So I can give you more of that one-in-a-million sound
More of that weather-in-the-village sound
More of that put-your-hands-to-the-ceiling sound
If you ever been down, then you know how I'm feelin' now
I don't need to tell you who I am
So I'ma take you all the way back again

[Pre-Chorus]
'Cause I've been all the way to Rio
I've been down the river, baby, I've been home
And I'm sitting in a bossa nova dream
I could never really be

[Chorus]
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Your everything, everything, everything
Everything, everything, everything
Everything, everything, everything
